stories.title: Sachin Tendulkar invests in Recykal
stories.summary: Former cricketer Sachin Tendulkar has joined the cap table of waste management startup Recykal. The investment extends a $23 million bridge round closed in June. The company says it aims to use technology to drive behavioural change across one billion people. The size of the investment was not disclosed.

stories.title: Sachin Tendulkar invests in Recykal, a waste management technology platform
stories.summary: Former cricketer Sachin Tendulkar has invested in Hyderabad-based Recykal, a technology platform for waste management and circular economy, as a strategic investor. His investment extends the $23 million bridge round the company closed in June. Tendulkar will help the company in its campaign to make

stories.title: Morsa raises $1.5 million for manufacturing automation
stories.summary: Morsa has raised $1.5 million in a pre-seed round led by Jackson Square Ventures. The startup, founded in June 2026, is building an autonomous AI Chief Operating Officer for manufacturing plants. It plans to use the capital to expand deployments across facilities in India and the United States.

stories.title: QB MEN raises pre-seed funding for menswear brand
stories.summary: Jaipur-based D2C menswear brand QB MEN has raised an undisclosed amount in a pre-seed round led by BeyondSeed. The startup plans to focus on storytelling and content creation to target 100 percent year-on-year growth. The investment will support brand-building initiatives rather than inventory financing.

stories.title: MistEO raises ₹18 crore for climate intelligence
stories.summary: Climate intelligence startup MistEO has raised ₹18 crore in a seed round led by MGF-Kavachh. The company provides weather risk insights to banks and insurers. It plans to use the capital to scale its Climate Decision Intelligence platform and expand its presence in Asian markets.

stories.title: Desible.ai secures Rs 32 crore for AI automation
stories.summary: Desible.ai has raised Rs 32 crore in a Seed Plus round led by Prime Venture Partners. The startup is building an AI-powered workflow orchestration platform for financial institutions. It plans to use the fresh capital to strengthen its agentic AI capabilities and expand its compliance infrastructure.

stories.title: Greenjoules raises Rs 150 crore for renewable fuel
stories.summary: Renewable fuels company Greenjoules has raised Rs 150 crore in a Series B round co-led by Amazon's Smbhav Venture Fund and Climate Pledge Fund. The company plans to use the capital to increase production capacity. It also secured a Rs 100 crore loan from the Technology Development Board.

stories.title: Live2.ai raises $13 million in pre-series B round
stories.summary: Live2.ai has raised $13 million in a pre-series B round led by IvyCap Ventures. The AI company plans to use the funds to support its expansion across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. The startup develops software products designed to help businesses with artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Google invests in creator economy startup Rigi
stories.summary: Creator economy startup Rigi has raised ₹10 crore from Google International at a valuation of approximately ₹670 crore. The investment marks the tech giant's entry into the company's shareholder base. Rigi plans to use the capital to expand its presence in the digital content market.

stories.title: Olyv raises ₹57.62 crore in extended series C
stories.summary: Digital lending platform Olyv has raised ₹57.62 crore in an extended Series C round led by Nippon India Digital. Existing investor Fundamentum also participated in the transaction. The company allotted compulsorily convertible preference shares and equity shares to complete the funding.

stories.title: Hundo Pizza raises Rs 7.5 crore in maiden funding
stories.summary: Delivery-first pizza brand Hundo Pizza has raised Rs 7.5 crore in its first institutional funding round led by Titan Capital. The company plans to use the capital to expand across Mumbai and enter a new city. It is targeting an annualised revenue run rate of Rs 60 crore.

stories.summary: Indian climate and weather intelligence startup mistEO has raised ₹18 crore in a seed funding round led by MGF-Kavachh, a SEBI-registered Category II Alternative Investment Fund. Seafund and other investors also participated in the round, while Key Venture acted as the financial adviser to the

stories.title: 4Minds closes series A at $500 million valuation
stories.summary: Contextual AI startup 4Minds has closed a $15 million Series A round at a $500 million post-money valuation. The company extracts data from enterprise platforms into a knowledge graph. It allows enterprises to deploy private AI models inside their own cloud or air-gapped environments.

stories.title: LangChain hits $3 billion valuation
stories.summary: Agent management startup LangChain has raised $300 million in a Series C round led by CapitalG, reaching a $3 billion valuation. The company, which began as an open source project, now focuses on managing AI agents. Its valuation has more than doubled in one year.

stories.title: Agentic AI startups lead weekly funding rounds
stories.summary: Agentic AI startups dominated the week's largest funding deals, including a $1 billion Series A for Mirendil and $750 million for Mercor. While AI-related financings remained the primary focus, the list also included deals in the biotech, fintech and enterprise software sectors.

stories.title: Kutlerri.ai raises $4 million for restaurant AI
stories.summary: Kutlerri.ai has raised $4 million from Narahari Investments to expand its AI-powered solutions for restaurants. The startup plans to scale its AI Catering Sales Agent and launch three additional agents currently in beta. It uses a performance-linked pricing model for its restaurant operator clients.

stories.title: Kutlerri.ai Raises $4 Million to Scale AI Agents for Restaurant Businesses
stories.summary: Kutlerri.ai Raises $4 Million to Scale AI Agents for Restaurant Businesses Kutlerri.ai has raised $4 million from Narahari Investments to scale its AI-powered restaurant solutions and launch new products. Houston- and Bhubaneswar-based Kutlerri.ai has raised $4 million in funding from Houston-based Narahari Investments to expand

stories.title: Haoyang Data Center 1 secures $600 million for Thailand project
stories.summary: Thailand-based Haoyang Data Center 1 has secured financing facilities worth up to $590 million, plus an additional THB 610 million, or approximately $18.8 million. The capital is earmarked for the first phase of a major data centre project in Thailand. The funding is now secured.

stories.title: Q-CTRL becomes Australia's first quantum unicorn
stories.summary: Sydney-based Q-CTRL has raised $290 million in a Series C round, valuing the quantum software company at more than $1 billion. The round was led by Salesforce Ventures with participation from the federal government and AMD. The company is now officially a unicorn.

stories.title: Fractile raises $720 million to build AI chips
stories.summary: British startup Fractile has raised $720 million in a Series C round to design AI chips aimed at cutting inference costs. The government values the company at more than 5 billion pounds, hoping the hardware will underpin the future economy. It calls itself a frontier AI company.

stories.title: Nectar launches AI agent for influencer marketing
stories.summary: Marketing operating system Nectar is launching a Creator Agent designed to automate influencer outreach, partnership management and campaign tracking. Founded by former Meta employees, the startup says the agent handles manual tasks like finding creators and monitoring results. Influencer marketing now comes with an automated assistant.

stories.title: Dallas AI startup 4Minds raises $15 million
stories.summary: Dallas-based 4Minds has raised $15 million in a Series A round at a $500 million post-money valuation. The startup, which emerged from stealth in April, plans to use the funds to expand sales and marketing teams. It is currently halfway to unicorn status.

stories.title: Indian fintech investment doubles in third quarter
stories.summary: Indian fintech companies raised $1.3 billion across 44 deals in the third quarter of 2026, a 2.3x increase from the same period last year. Average deal value surged 2.6x to $30.4 million as investors prioritised larger transactions. The sector is seeing fewer deals but more money.

stories.title: SoftBank offloads Meesho shares worth 1,855 crore
stories.summary: SoftBank has offloaded 7.6 crore shares of ecommerce firm Meesho in a block deal worth 1,885.2 crore. The stake was sold at a 4% discount to Friday's closing price. Fidelity, Societe Generale, and several mutual funds acquired the shares. The market was apparently ready to buy.

stories.title: Razorpay receives SEBI approval for 6,000 crore IPO
stories.summary: Fintech major Razorpay has received SEBI approval for an IPO expected to raise 5,000 to 6,000 crore. The offering aims for a 5 billion dollar valuation, lower than the 7.5 billion dollar valuation the company commanded in 2021. Market conditions will determine the final date.

stories.title: Zelio E-Mobility net profit grows 164 percent
stories.summary: BSE SME-listed Zelio E-Mobility reported a consolidated net profit of 31.4 crore for the first half of fiscal year 2026-27, up from 11.9 crore in the year-ago period. Operating revenue grew 120% to 296.7 crore, while total expenses more than doubled to 261.5 crore.

stories.title: Paytm shares reclaim listing price barrier
stories.summary: Shares of Paytm parent One97 Communications rose 1.85% to 1,958.80 on Friday, marking a record high. The stock has reclaimed the 1,900 mark for the first time since its 2021 market debut. The company has surged nearly 50% this year, rewarding those who stayed invested.

stories.title: Crystal Crop Protection sets IPO price band
stories.summary: Crystal Crop Protection has fixed the price band for its 455 crore IPO at 259 to 272 per share. The offering includes a fresh issue of 355 crore and an offer for sale of 3.7 million shares. Subscription opens on November 18 and closes November 20.

stories.title: Microsoft outage disrupts global operations
stories.summary: A Microsoft outage affecting Outlook, Teams, and Copilot disrupted workplaces and airlines for over 20 hours starting Thursday. The company reported it was pursuing multiple workstreams to restore the environment. Employees were forced to rely on alternative communication channels to keep work moving.

stories.title: Tata Motors records loss as JLR cuts guidance
stories.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles recorded a 5,451 crore loss for the September quarter, following job cuts and asset write-downs at Jaguar Land Rover. JLR has lowered its fiscal year 2026-27 operating margin guidance. The company previously posted a profit driven by a one-time demerger gain.

stories.title: Reliance plans 1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Reliance plans to invest 1 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh to establish compressed biogas plants. Executive director Anant M Ambani stated the project will generate 60,000 crore in revenue for the state and create 3 lakh job opportunities. The company expects farmers to strengthen India's energy security.

stories.title: Tata Trusts trustees contest leadership criticism
stories.summary: Tata Trusts Vice-Chairmen Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh have challenged Darius Khambata’s criticism of the Tata Sons board. The trustees accused Khambata of providing an incomplete account regarding leadership and listing disputes. The disagreement over the group holding company’s future remains active.

stories.title: Vodafone-Idea seeks bank funding for network expansion
stories.summary: Vodafone-Idea is in advanced talks with public sector banks to secure a portion of its planned funding. The company aims to draw down 35,000 crore in funded facilities and 10,000 crore in credit to support network expansion. The company plans to spend the money on its capital expenditure requirements.

stories.title: India Inc finds workarounds during Microsoft outage
stories.summary: A global Microsoft outage brought corporate inboxes to a standstill across India. While Outlook and Copilot failed, many companies shifted their internal correspondence to Microsoft Teams. Some employees viewed the disruption as a hassle, while others celebrated the early arrival of the weekend.

stories.title: Microsoft services recover after 18 hour global outage
stories.summary: Microsoft services are back online after an outage left users without access for 18 hours across 74 countries. The disruption affected businesses, schools, and airlines. Microsoft stated the event was not a cyberattack, but rather the result of overwhelmed servers responsible for establishing connections.

stories.title: Blinkit expands ambulance service to Bengaluru
stories.summary: Blinkit has launched its ambulance service in Bengaluru, marking its first expansion into South India. The company is operating four ambulances across two depots in the city. Residents can request the service through the Blinkit app. The company has also opened a second ambulance training academy.

stories.title: Indian investors increase trading of Nvidia shares
stories.summary: Vested Finance reports a 400 percent jump in trading activity for Nvidia shares among Indian investors. The stock accounted for 70 percent of the platform's combined buying and selling volume over the last 10 sessions. Investors appear to be monitoring the chipmaker closely.

stories.title: iD Fresh Food encourages employees to quit and start businesses
stories.summary: iD Fresh Food has announced an entrepreneurship policy that encourages its employees to quit and build their own businesses. The company offers to support these departures and provides an option for staff to return. Most companies try to retain their best employees, but this one is different.

research.title: Advancing Weighted Partial MaxSAT Solving via Differentiable GPU Guidance
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a GPU-CPU hybrid framework for Weighted Partial MaxSAT (WPMAX-SAT) that complements state-of-the-art CPU solvers with differentiable GPU optimization. The GPU stage directly optimizes instance-specific categorical decision parameters without a training dataset or a pretrained. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Can an AI Agent Be Epistemically Akratic? Higher-Order Evidence & the Limits of Self-Correction
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: When we judge that our reasoning was defective, it seems plausible that we should abandon the conclusion it produced. This thought has special force for AI agents built to assess and correct their own work. Yet. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Early Signals, Strong Decisions: Prefix-Guided Sampling for Parallel Test-Time Scaling
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Parallel test-time scaling (TTS) has been shown to enhance reasoning in large language models by generating and aggregating multiple independent reasoning paths. Internal confidence scores can further improve this process by identifying paths of varying quality. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Edge-Native Multimodal RAG: Hardware-Aware Quantization and Architectural Optimization for Consumer GPUs
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Deployment of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for Edge-AI is constrained by memory and bandwidth limitations. A standard 7B parameter model consumes 14 GB Video Random Access Memory (VRAM) in half-precision (FP16), precluding co-location of vector indices and. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Effective Teacher Support for Reasoning Distillation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Forward-KL language-model distillation normally computes dense teacher and student scores over the full vocabulary at every supervised position, making training and stored teacher targets expensive. We instead distill from the teacher's highest-probability vocabulary fraction, renormalizing the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
